contractVersion.description: Contract version. Every document carries it so a runtime can refuse what it does not understand instead of guessing.

marketId.description: Market identifier, lower snake case (e.g. cn_stock, hk_stock, us_equity, crypto_spot). The registry of known ids lives in docs/MARKETS.md; runtimes may support a subset and must reject ids they do not know.

timeframe.description: Bar period. Canonical spellings only: '1h' not '60m'. 'tick' means event-driven evaluation on every market-data frame and cannot be bar-backtested.

symbol.description: Instrument code as the market spells it. For markets where the venue disambiguates the code (cn_*, hk_stock) the venue suffix is part of the identity: 600000.SH, 00700.HK. A bare code there is a different series, not a shorthand.

number.description: A scalar setting: a literal number, {"const": n}, or a reference to a key in dsl.params.

producer.description: Who produced this document and how. Needed for multiple-testing correction and for diffing iterations.

name.description: Tool, agent or team name with version, e.g. my-agent@0.3.1.

searchTrials.description: How many candidates were evaluated before this one was submitted. Input to multiple-testing correction (deflated Sharpe). Required for AI_AGENT and FACTOR_MINER. Under-reporting loosens the gate; runtimes should cross-check it against their own call logs.

parent.description: Identifier of the previous iteration, for diffs.

riskProfile.description: Per-strategy risk overrides. Anything omitted inherits the runtime's account-level settings. Percentages are 0-100, notionals are in the instrument's quote currency.

direction.description: Ranking direction. DESC = higher is better. Required with no default: a flipped direction raises no error, it just loses money for a long time.
